entities.summary: A four-hour underground historical journey combining authentic salt workings, a mining train, multimedia interpretation and an underground boat crossing.
entities.description: Bochnia’s strongest route is a controlled underground journey rather than a chamber-only mine tour: visitors descend by lift, travel by mining train, walk historic workings, encounter multimedia interpretation and cross part of the mine by boat. The long route is physically substantial and language mode matters.
entities.whyWorthwhile: Transport, authentic workings and theatrical interpretation combine into one of Europe’s most experiential industrial-heritage visits.

entities.summary: A multi-site underground industrial destination combining a 320 m mine descent, machinery, mine transport and the Queen Louise underground boat route.
entities.description: Zabrze’s two flagship underground routes work best as one destination: Guido provides deep coal-mine history, machinery and transport, while Queen Louise adds a water-level adit and boat journey. A combined visit can fill most of a day but requires deliberate route, transfer and language planning.
entities.whyWorthwhile: Few industrial sites offer this much movement, machinery, darkness and authentic underground space in one regional destination.

location.address: Guido: 3 Maja 93; Queen Louise: Wolności 408, Zabrze
